note.es: Alerta real, no solo cierre de finde: el snapshot lleva 27.6 h sin reconstruirse (supera el umbral explicito de 24 h para fin de semana) y el pre-asia del viernes nunca corrio (ultimo heartbeat fue pre-ny del viernes a mediodia, luego salto directo al weekly del sabado) - huele a que tanto el cron de Netlify como el scheduler del Session Analyst se detuvieron el viernes por la tarde. Ademas persisten dos anomalias ya conocidas de corridas previas: 3reads@ES muerto hace ~39 h y orb@CL frozen vs command (~0.33%, revisar TradingView). Recomendado: revisar el cron sa-bus-snapshot en Netlify y el scheduler del SA antes de que abra Asia del domingo.
note.en: This looks like a real outage, not just the weekend close: the snapshot hasn't rebuilt in 27.6 h (past the explicit 24 h weekend ceiling) and Friday's pre-asia run never fired (the last heartbeat was Friday's midday pre-ny, then it jumped straight to Saturday's weekly) - suggesting both the Netlify snapshot cron and the Session Analyst scheduler stalled Friday afternoon. Two previously-known anomalies also persist: 3reads@ES has been dead for ~39 h, and orb@CL is frozen vs command (~0.33%, check TradingView). Recommend checking the sa-bus-snapshot Netlify cron and the SA scheduler before Sunday's Asia open.
